title: HelperFSReadParams
description: Params of the helper fs service's read op. A whole-file read asks for the entire file and its version, and therefore starts at 0; a range read asks for a window and is answered with the object's identity instead. Length is bounded by the files.read ceiling plus one: the extra byte is the truncation probe's room, and a longer request is a page that cannot exist.

path.description: The absolute, clean path to read. Symlinks are followed once by the provider, and the object actually opened is what the answer describes.

offset.description: The first byte to return. A whole-file read requires 0.

length.description: The maximum number of bytes to return. Positive; at most 2 MiB + 1 (the files.read ceiling plus the truncation probe's byte).

whole.description: Read the entire file and answer its version. A file larger than `length` is refused `too-large` rather than truncated, because a prefix is not the file and the version would describe bytes the caller never saw.
